rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 2010).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2011 as 'Vélasquez'.
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in before 2017 as 'La Reine Marie-Antoinette'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong fragrance. 40 to 45 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, high-centered, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: MEI816

[Source: Marie Antoinette' is a synonym for the Japanese market.
The Queen Marie-Antoinette is meant here a character from the manga series "The Rose of Versailles" by Riyoko Ikeda.]
